llm_response.reason: While there are numerous complaints about poor customer service, inaccurate delivery times, missing or damaged items, and confusing assembly instructions, these are indicative of legitimate business logistics or quality issues rather than scam characteristics. There is no evidence of unusually low prices, promises of guaranteed returns, fake company/investment claims, suspicious payment methods, requests for remote access, or spoofing of well-known brands. WHOIS data corroborates the business identity and historic legitimacy.
